prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return solution.rs.
Required API: pub fn live_cache(entries: &[[&str;4]], now:i64) -> Option<Vec<String>>
Behavior: Each entry is key,value,writtenAt,ttl; keys match ASCII [a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*. now, writtenAt and ttl must be integers in 0..10,000,000, and writtenAt+ttl must not exceed 10,000,000 when ttl is nonzero. Reject duplicate keys. ttl zero never expires; otherwise live exactly while now < writtenAt+ttl. Return key=value pairs in Unicode code-point key order.
Visible example: at now 15, a value written at 10 with ttl 5 is expired, while ttl 0 remains live.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: use std::collections::HashSet;pub fn live_cache(e:&[[&str;4]],n:i64)->Option<Vec<String>>{if n<0||n>10000000{return None}let mut s=HashSet::new();let mut o=vec![];for x in e{let key=x[0].as_bytes();if key.is_empty()||!key[0].is_ascii_lowercase()||!key.iter().all(|c|c.is_ascii_lowercase()||c.is_ascii_digit()||*c==b'-')||x[0].ends_with('-')||x[0].contains("--")||!s.insert(x[0]){return None}let w:i64=x[2].parse().ok()?;let t:i64=x[3].parse().ok()?;if w.to_string()!=x[2]||t.to_string()!=x[3]||w<0||w>10000000||t<0||t>10000000||(t>0&&w+t>10000000){return None}if t==0||n<w+t{o.push(format!("{}={}",x[0],x[1]))}}o.sort();Some(o)}
